title: Public money in the 30 current arenas, by kind
note: The five parts of the expanded total. Tax breaks are property-tax breaks and taxes diverted to arena debt; the federal cost of tax-exempt bonds is not included.
method: select * from ( select 1 as ord, 'build' as key, 'Building the arenas' as name, sum(public_2026_m) as public_2026_m from items where core and kind = 'construction' union all select 2, 'reno', 'Renovations', sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'renovation' union all select 3, 'buy', 'Buying arenas', sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'purchase' union all select 4, 'pay', 'Yearly payments', sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'ongoing' union all select 5, 'breaks', 'Tax breaks', (select sum(coalesce(pilot_2026_m, 0)) from arenas) + (select sum(tax_break_cumulative_2026_m) from arenas where tax_break_in_expanded_total = 'Y')) order by ord
